notes.internal_inconsistency_note: 19 + 13 + 1 = 33, not the stated total of 23. Retained verbatim: a document that contradicts itself is a distinct failure mode from two documents contradicting each other, and the agent must catch both.

passages.text: Surface water collected rapidly, resulting in the formation of a supraglacial lake of area 0.725 sq. km by July 7.
The lake had drained to 0.60 sq. km by July 8.
The report tallies 23 human casualties: 19 deaths, 13 missing and 1 injured.
The flood is attributed to an outburst from the Pyurepu Glacier on the Nepal-China border. DHM found no heavy rainfall beforehand; NDRRMA had initially reported an ice-rock landslide.
